sleep_driver_pattern: manual-multi (run_sleep_cycle() called directly every SLEEP_INTERVAL episodes in training loop)

P0_sleep_cycle_write_counters.desc: P0 GATE (5 checks, all must clear). 2 unchanged from 436c/436d (sleep-pass write/rollout counters); 3 NEW in 436e (waking writepath engagement, occupancy sufficiency, Adam-drift-neutralization calibration) -- see failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436d-methodology-check_2026-08-07 Recommendation #4.

C1_primary_slot_cosine_sim_occupied_only.desc: SOLE PASS/FAIL GATE once P0 is met. slot_cosine_sim_occupied_only(SWS_THEN_REM) < slot_cosine_sim_occupied_only(WAKING_ONLY) in >= 3/5 seeds. Computed over ONLY slots that received >=1 ContextMemory.write() call this run (tracks write()'s own min_idx directly) -- the corrected instrument.

C4_arc045_slot_separation_threshold.desc: SECONDARY, non-gating. slot_separation in SWS_THEN_REM > 0.3 in >= 3/5 seeds. Unchanged formula from 436d -- a read-side visitation statistic, independent of the write-occupancy cosine confound.

preconditions.name: sws_context_memory_writes_occur
preconditions.control: sum of ContextMemory.write() calls (sws_n_writes, returned by agent.run_sws_schema_pass() via run_sleep_cycle()) across every SWS_THEN_REM sleep pass, pooled across all 5 seeds -- must be > 0 for the C1 comparison to test the mechanism rather than an unrecorded no-op. Unchanged from 436c/436d.

preconditions.name: rem_attribution_rollouts_occur
preconditions.control: sum of hippocampal replay rollouts (rem_n_rollouts) across every SWS_THEN_REM sleep pass, pooled across all 5 seeds. Unchanged from 436c/436d.

preconditions.name: waking_writepath_engaged
preconditions.control: sum of ContextMemory.write() calls fired by the per-tick sense_only hook (agent.py:4847) across all WAKING_ONLY seeds, pooled across all 5 seeds -- NEW in 436e. Confirms the docstring point-3 fix (giving WAKING_ONLY a real write path via sd016_writepath_mode='sense_only') actually engaged this run; F1 of the methodology-check autopsy found this pooled to exactly 0 in 436d.

preconditions.name: sufficient_occupancy_for_c1
preconditions.control: count of seeds (of 5) where BOTH WAKING_ONLY and SWS_THEN_REM have >=2 occupied slots (the minimum for an off-diagonal pairwise mean to exist) -- NEW in 436e, the direct fix for F6 (seeds 13/200 sat inside the untouched-bank null in 436d, making C1 unsatisfiable there by construction and silently shrinking the effective denominator below the registered 3/5).

preconditions.name: adam_drift_neutralized
preconditions.control: max |z-score| of the NO_WRITES calibration arm's raw whole-bank cosine (slot_cosine_sim_raw_whole_bank) against the freshly-derived untouched-bank null (mean=0.000019, sd=0.007789, n_draws=500), across all 5 seeds -- NEW in 436e, the empirical check for docstring points 4/5/6 (F5: WAKING_ONLY's 436d spread 0.0009-0.47 was fully reproduced by Adam drift alone on context_memory.memory with zero write() calls). context_memory.memory.requires_grad_(False) plus zero write() calls on this arm should hold its raw cosine inside the null; a large z here means something is perturbing the bank that the calibration model does not account for.

arc045_abs_reference_legacy.note: Calibrated against the PRE-436d write-gate defect. NOT recomputed against the repaired path, NOT used for gating. See module docstring point 5.

notes: SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166 slot-differentiation retest on an OCCUPIED-SLOTS-ONLY slot_cosine_sim DV. Discharges the DV-repair obligation recorded by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436d-methodology-check_2026-08-07 (confirmed, user-confirmed), which found 436d's C1 metric (whole-bank mean off-diagonal cosine, no occupancy mask) fatally confounded on five independent grounds: WAKING_ONLY performed zero ContextMemory writes (F1); an unwritten bank reads ~0 not ~1.0, so ARC-045's near-1.0 calibration point was an artifact of the write-gate defect 436d itself repaired (F2); the statistic is a PRODUCT of similarity and occupancy, not similarity alone (F3); this makes it anti-correlated with the differentiation mechanism it was written to detect -- a 12-slot near-orthogonal arm scored 8x WORSE than a 1-slot arm (F4); WAKING_ONLY's entire observed 0.0009-0.47 spread was reproduced by Adam-optimizer drift alone on context_memory.memory with ZERO writes (F5); and 2/5 seeds sat inside the untouched-bank null, making C1 unsatisfiable there by construction (F6). This letter implements all six items of the autopsy's Recommendation #4: (1) statistic over occupied slots only, tracking write()'s own min_idx; (2) similarity and occupancy reported separately, never as their product; (3) WAKING_ONLY given a real write path (sd016_writepath_mode='sense_only', held constant vs SWS_THEN_REM, which shares it plus the offline consolidation writes); (4) Adam drift neutralized (context_memory.memory.requires_grad_(False), all conditions); (5) the predicted baseline re-derived empirically at run time rather than reusing ARC-045's near-1.0 figure; (6) a NO_WRITES negative control added, checked against the re-derived null as a P0 calibration gate. The manipulation under test is unchanged from every prior letter: SWS_THEN_REM (offline consolidation) vs WAKING_ONLY (online writes only). The OLD whole-bank statistic is still recorded verbatim (slot_cosine_sim_raw_whole_bank) for audit continuity, but never gates. Conditions, training loop, action-selection wiring, seeds and C1's shape (paired, directional, >=3/5 seeds) are otherwise unchanged from 436d.
